title: mimi-mls: implement the mls-extensions §4.4 safe exporter, not just RFC 9420 §8.5
description:
Found 2026-11-23 reading the call-keying machinery (bead
mimid-1wgh.37.106).

WHAT MIMID HAS: mimi-mls member.rs:2149 `export_secret`, documented as
"MLS-Exporter(label, context, length) for the current epoch (RFC 9420
§8.5)". That is the plain exporter.

WHAT IT DOES NOT HAVE: the forward-secure exporter of
draft-ietf-mls-extensions-11 §4.4 "Exported Secrets". §4.4 exists
BECAUSE the RFC 9420 one is not forward-secure: "The MLS Exporter
functionality described in Section 8.5 of [RFC9420] does not provide
forward security for exported secrets, because the exporter_secret is
not deleted after a secret has been derived."

The safe exporter instead:
- derives `application_export_secret` from the epoch secret with the
  label "application_export", as the other Table 4 secrets are derived;
- builds an Exporter Tree of 2^16 leaves, one per ComponentID, with the
  structure of RFC 9420 §9's Secret Tree;
- gives SafeExportSecret(ComponentID) = the leaf's tree_node_secret;
- and on generating one, "the MLS implementation MUST regard that
  component's exported secret as 'consumed', and delete any source key
  material according to the deletion schedule in Section 9.2".

WHY IT MATTERS HERE AND NOT ONLY IN THEORY: this is the mechanism an
MLS-keyed call would use for its media keys, one secret per app
component. mimid cannot key a call from the group without it, and the
RFC 9420 exporter is the wrong tool because a leaked exporter_secret
retroactively exposes every derived media key.

It also has a use beyond calls: any future app component that needs key
material gets it this way rather than inventing a label.

CHECK FIRST whether OpenMLS implements §4.4; if it does, this is a
wiring job in mimi-mls, and if not it is a fork patch and lands with the
fork debt of mimid-m12g and mimid-1wgh.4.69. The deletion MUST is the
part to get right: a consumed secret must take its source material with
it, which is a storage question as much as a crypto one.

Not started.
notes:
ALREADY SHIPPED, in commit 318561ad ("feat(mls,hub): the safe exporter,
and the parent-dependent subset rule"). This bead was written against the
code as it stood and was never closed; the description's "Not started" was
already wrong when it was filed.

ITS "CHECK FIRST" ANSWERED: OPENMLS IMPLEMENTS §4.4. On the pinned fork
rev f1680d98, behind the `extensions-draft` feature:
MlsGroup::safe_export_secret(crypto, storage, component_id) in
openmls/src/group/mls_group/exporting.rs, over an ApplicationExportTree
(schedule/application_export_tree.rs), with a StorageProvider pair
write_application_export_tree / application_export_tree. So this was a
wiring job, not fork debt: no patch-branch work, and none of
mimid-m12g's or mimid-1wgh.4.69's fork debt was added.

WHAT IS IN MIMID. mimi-mls member.rs Member::safe_export_secret(identity,
component_id), beside the RFC 9420 §8.5 export_secret, with the rustdoc
saying which to prefer and why. Agent::media_secret in mimid-agent-core
reads it under component_id MEDIA_KEYS once per epoch and keeps the result
in memory (mimid-agent-core/src/media.rs, MediaSecret: zeroized, no
Display, no Serialize, Debug prints nothing). The JMAP surface reaches it
as VTCCall/exportMediaSecret (mimid-agent-jmap vtc_backend.rs).

THE DELETION MUST, which this bead called the part to get right, holds in
both halves:

  - in memory: tests/safe_exporter.rs
    a_component_exports_once_in_an_epoch -- a second read of the same
    component in the same epoch fails, another component still works.
  - IN THE STORE, which was the half NOT covered and is the test added
    when closing this: the_puncture_survives_reloading_the_member reloads
    the group through Member::load, i.e. through the same storage provider
    a restart reads, and the consumed leaf is still consumed. If the
    puncture were only in the loaded MlsGroup, a restart would hand the
    secret out again and §4.4's forward security would be gone.

Also already held down by that file: every member derives the same secret
for a component, a different component is a different secret, a Commit
rolls it, and a removed member exports nothing.

ONE CONSEQUENCE FOUND AND FILED, not fixed: an agent that restarts inside
an epoch cannot get that epoch's media secret back, because the puncture
is in the store and the secret was not. That is §4.4 working as specified,
so it is not a defect in this bead's work, but it means a crash during a
call cannot be recovered from until the epoch moves. Pinned by
tests/call_rooms.rs
an_agent_that_restarts_inside_an_epoch_loses_the_media_secret, documented
in media.rs's # Limitations and in Agent::media_secret's # Errors, and the
decision about what a call should do is bead mimid-1wgh.129 (labelled
human; my recommendation there is an empty Commit to roll the epoch).

NOT DONE, and out of this bead: the mls-extensions §4.5 application PSKType
and §4.6 app_data_dictionary are separate mechanisms in the same section
of the draft and are not this bead's. mimid uses the exporter only for
media keys so far; the second use the description imagined (any future app
component gets key material this way rather than inventing a label) is
available as soon as something wants it.
